_note: Evaluator-owned scoring roster. 'required' methods are always scored and receive worst values when absent or invalid. 'comparisons' are scored only from evaluator-owned frozen predictions in this directory's frozen/ folder (produced by the reference pipeline), never from outputs/. 'gate' is the decoupling constraint: a scored method whose appearance-free render (average-appearance PSNR after colour correction) falls more than 'margin' dB below the frozen vanilla 3DGS render fails the whole run.
